title: PR template still says to dispatch pre-merge-platform-suites.yml and has no Test Evidence block; CONTRIBUTING's Test Evidence template has drifted from DEV-PROCESS
description:
## Summary

For when you have a moment, Stuart. Two small bits of drift in the merge-flow paperwork you own, spotted while preparing the [KS-1354](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-1354/bump-systemtest-k6-210-230-grafanak6-v220-v230-released) PR. The PR template still suggests dispatching the retired `pre-merge-platform-suites.yml` and has no Test Evidence block. And the Test Evidence templates in `CONTRIBUTING.md` and `DEV-PROCESS.md` have drifted apart. Nothing has been changed. Thank you.

+++ Evidence (develop `63db8a383`, 2026-09-28) and what "done" could look like

**1.** `.github/pull_request_template.md` **and the adopted merge flow**

* It asks authors to dispatch `pre-merge-platform-suites.yml`. Root `CLAUDE.md` (*Merge flow*), `Blockchain/Dev/docs/DEV-PROCESS.md` and [KS-441](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-441/akto-ci-scan-throughput-21-s-local-vs-10-min-in-the-isolated-pr-akto) say not to: Actions is retired, and the gate is a local four-suite run.
* It has no Test Evidence block (touched / ran / NOT run / migrations+config), which the merge flow relies on. `grep -ci 'Test Evidence' .github/pull_request_template.md` → **0**.

**2. The two Test Evidence templates**

`DEV-PROCESS.md` says it uses the same wording as `CONTRIBUTING.md`, but:

* `grep -c 'Cross-cutting guards' Blockchain/Dev/docs/DEV-PROCESS.md` → **2**
* `grep -c 'Cross-cutting guards' Blockchain/Dev/CONTRIBUTING.md` → **0**

`CONTRIBUTING.md` also lacks DEV-PROCESS's Schemathesis "failing SET + diff vs develop" wording.

**Why here:** it belongs to the process [KS-685](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-685/define-the-work-test-commit-manual-merge-process-while-ci-is) set up (now Deployed to UAT), so there was no open ticket to add it to.

**Related:** [KS-1049](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-1049/a-prs-test-evidence-must-state-whether-the-preflight-ran-the-hook) (Kamil — Test Evidence should say whether the preflight ran; the template would be its home) · [KS-1012](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-1012/the-require-pr-gates-ruleset-survived-the-actions-retirement-7) (the `require-pr-gates` ruleset outlived Actions).

**Done when**

- [ ] The PR template no longer mentions dispatching the retired workflow.
- [ ] The PR template seeds the Test Evidence block, including a preflight-ran line ([KS-1049](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-1049/a-prs-test-evidence-must-state-whether-the-preflight-ran-the-hook)).
- [ ] `CONTRIBUTING.md` and `DEV-PROCESS.md` share one Test Evidence template (one canonical copy; the other points at it).

+++

nodes.title: Refs KS-1366: PR template stops telling authors to dispatch the retired pre-merge workflow

nodes.body:
**BLUF:** pull request 1881 (https://github.com/Secuura/Distributed_Secuura/pull/1881, head `ba52d62e1cfe`) removes the instruction to dispatch the retired `pre-merge-platform-suites.yml` from the PR template, the first of this ticket's three done-when items. Documentation only; raised for Wednesday's delta check (no gate); not merged. This ticket stays open.

**What changed:** three lines in `.github/pull_request_template.md`: the note now says to run each suite's pre-merge tier locally against the stack and not to dispatch the workflow (KS 441, Actions is retired). One held Spark pass, tree-identical to its golden, applied strictly; no hand edit.

**Not done:** the template still has no Test Evidence block with a preflight-ran line, and `CONTRIBUTING.md` and `DEV-PROCESS.md` still carry two different Test Evidence templates (the ticket's second and third items). The root `CLAUDE.md` contradiction (lines 266 to 271 against line 321) is filed separately as KS 1915.
